# UBOSS

> UBOSS helps local service businesses in Boston and the North Shore stop losing evenings to quotes, invoices, follow-ups, and paperwork. Simple systems handle the repetitive work, and the owner gets clearer answers about how the business is really doing.

Free 15-minute discovery call, in English or Spanish, with founder Robert Gutierrez: [book a time](https://cal.com/robg-uboss/discovery-call).

## What clients get

- Less time on the repetitive tasks that pile up daily, weekly, and monthly, so admin stops eating the end of the day.
- Customers who hear back fast and clearly, and a team that always knows the current status without anyone chasing.
- Clearer answers about how the business is doing, built around the numbers that matter most to that business (such as what it costs to win a customer and what each effort returns), as trust and access to the data grow.
- The tools already in use connected to each other, and paperwork captured and easy to find instead of lost.
- A quick start: most straightforward builds are live within one to two weeks, with no long-term contract (the monthly side is month-to-month).

## Booking

- [Free 15-minute discovery call](https://cal.com/robg-uboss/discovery-call): Book a free 15-minute discovery call (English or Spanish) by phone or video. Pick any open time.
- [60-minute strategy session](https://cal.com/robg-uboss/uboss-strategy): Book a longer working session on one specific problem (English or Spanish). Pick any open time.
- Phone: (339) 245-1665 (call or text)

## Good to know

- Serves trades and local service businesses: landscaping and lawn care, cleaning, general contracting, plumbing and HVAC, auto body and repair, property management, and caterers and food entrepreneurs.
- Not offered: full-service restaurants, point-of-sale or delivery-platform integration (Toast, Square, Clover, Uber Eats, Grubhub, DoorDash). Online payments are planned, not live.
- Pricing is a custom quote after the free call: a one-time setup fee for the build plus a month-to-month monthly fee. Fixed public packages are not published.
- The AI runs on hardware UBOSS hosts and secures itself, so customer information is not scattered across big AI platforms.
- Every page above also has a markdown version at the same URL with `.md` appended.
